releaseNotes: Fixes clipped laptop layout with readable card heights, scrolling and narrow-window stacking. Retains the Intune enrollment row. Existing Intune enrollment and update ownership telemetry preserved. Read-only hardware/reporting inventory; standalone maintenance pilot is not deployed. Inventory-only DEV 0.2.5.24: service 0.2.5.17, tray 1.0.0.16; detailed Windows Update and Office/Edge/Chrome/Adobe inventory. Preserves Safe Cleanup and Managed Updater fixes. Minimum updater 0.1.4.0. No remote update/install actions. HCSPC2025 validation before API production deployment.
